description: Declared discovery manifest for UCOS-CTRL-000001. This document is the ONLY place repository-specific names appear: platform/universal_control_plane hardcodes no repository path, no capability name, no artifact identifier and no engine list. Replace this document to specialise the same control plane for any other repository.

universe.name: Universal Control Plane
universe.description: The constitutional Engineering Operating System of the repository.
universe.vision: Every engineering object in the repository carries identity, registration, lineage, ownership, governance and certification, discovered from repository state rather than declared in code.

registry.description: The read-only 00-BOOK registry substrate, reached through engine.registry.RegistrySource. Filenames only — the directory is resolved by the reused adapter.

capability_catalog.description: The sealed capability catalogue produced by UCOS-RIE-001 and consumed by platform.repository_intelligence. Read as an artifact so control-plane discovery costs no repository-wide AST pass.

artifact_classes.description: Governance records: artifacts whose registered category places them under the governance programme.
Certification artifacts: certificates, certification determinations and certification readiness records.
Determination artifacts: recorded verdicts with rationale.
Evidence artifacts: measurement, verification and traceability records.
Registration artifacts: the registry, index and catalogue records that register other artifacts.

engine_taxonomy.description: How a discovered control-plane class is classified. Suffix decides membership; module decides layer. No engine is named here — membership is measured by introspecting the package.

governance_rules.message: every governed object must declare an owner
every governed object must be registered
every governed object must carry a resolvable version
an object may only be homed in a truth class eligible to own it
every governed object must carry at least one evidence record

certification_criteria.message: certification requires a GOVERNED governance state
certification requires zero CRITICAL governance violations
certification requires at least one evidence record

replay.description: Durable replay journal location, resolved beneath the caller's declared runtime root. The control plane never assumes a repository directory.
